ROC Curve Module¶

The roc class derives from plotting and provides ROC (Receiver Operating Characteristic) curve computation and storage for multi-class classifiers. It is used by the built-in AccuracyMetric to generate AUC tables after training.

Public Methods¶

Signature

Description

void build_ROC(std::string name, int kfold, std::vector<int>* label, std::vector<std::vector<double>>* scores)

Computes the ROC curves for classifier name, fold kfold, given ground-truth label (flat integer class vector) and scores (one row per event, one column per class). Results are stored in the internal roc_data and labels maps.

std::vector<roc_t*> get_ROC()

Returns pointers to all computed roc_t objects. The caller does not own the returned pointers (owned by roc).

Example:

roc roc_obj;
roc_obj.build_ROC("MyModel", 0, &truth_labels, &model_scores);
for (roc_t* r : roc_obj.get_ROC()) {
    std::cout << "AUC (class 0): " << r->_auc[0] << std::endl;
}

ROC curve computation and storage.

Header file for Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) curve plotting.

Declares roc_t (per-class ROC data) and roc (the computation class that inherits plotting).

Contains the roc class and associated data structures for calculating and plotting ROC curves from model scores and truth labels.

struct roc_t¶
#include <roc.h>

Holds the data for one ROC curve (one class, one k-fold, one model).

Structure containing raw and processed ROC curve data.

Stores the ROC curve data for one class and one k-fold.

Aggregates the ground-truth label arrays (truth) and classifier score arrays (scores) together with the computed true-positive rate (tpr_), false-positive rate (fpr_), and area-under-curve values (_auc) for a specific class index (cls) and k-fold (kfold). The truth and scores pointers are not owned by this struct.

Stores the target class (cls), cross-validation fold (kfold), model name, Area Under Curve (_auc), True Positive Rate (tpr_), and False Positive Rate (fpr_). Also retains pointers to the original truth labels and scores.

class roc : public plotting¶
#include <roc.h>

Computes ROC curves from classifier scores and truth labels.

Class for generating and plotting ROC curves.

Inherits plotting. Accumulates per-model, per-fold score and label data via build_ROC, then exposes the computed roc_t objects through get_ROC. The roc_data and labels maps hold the raw inputs keyed by model name and k-fold index. Internally the class allocates two-dimensional score/label matrices using the private generate helper. All allocated roc_t objects are freed in the destructor.

Inherits from the plotting class. It aggregates ROC data across multiple labels and folds, providing tools to build the ROC objects dynamically:

  • build_ROC: Computes and caches the ROC metrics for a given model/name and fold.

  • get_ROC: Returns the generated ROC structures for rendering.
